t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are groups of gnomes that take you to different colour baskets that have different amounts.

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 gnomes split into 2 groups. The green, orange, yellow and blue gnomes will take you to a yellow basket and the red, brown, pink and purple gnomes will take you to the red basket. if you start with any colour basket and it gives you a high number,stick with the basket. when the number of mushrooms gets to the numbers 2/1 switch to the other group. if you are given 1 or 0 after switching you have switched too early. E.G. Yellow= 3 or more mushrooms. Stay until 1 or 0 produced. Switch to red.
